title: Data Structures and Algorithms
author: CLRS
summary: A foundational textbook covering algorithms, data structures, complexity analysis, and problem-solving techniques used in modern software development.

title: Machine Learning
author: Tom Mitchell
summary: A classic introduction to machine learning concepts including supervised learning, decision trees, neural networks, and statistical learning methods.

title: Deep Learning
author: Ian Goodfellow
summary: A comprehensive guide to deep neural networks, representation learning, optimization techniques, and modern deep learning architectures.

title: Operating Systems
author: Galvin
summary: Explains operating system concepts including processes, memory management, scheduling, file systems, and concurrency.

title: Computer Networks
author: Kurose
summary: Introduces networking principles, internet protocols, network architecture, routing, congestion control, and distributed communication systems.

title: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach
author: Russell and Norvig
summary: A widely used AI textbook covering search, reasoning, planning, machine learning, knowledge representation, and intelligent agents.
